title: Reconcile hex adr review findings (441 findings, 21 NEEDS_ACTION ADRs)
superseded_reason: Premise was wrong: the 42 metadata findings are review-tool false positives (regex expects '- **Field**:' bullet format; existing 21 ADRs use '## Field' section format that 'hex adr list' parses correctly). ADR-2604211639 documents the grandfather rule; the one genuine gap (missing Authors) was fixed directly by adding '## Authors' sections to all 21 ADRs.

context.problem: hex adr review on 2026-04-21 reports 441 findings across 21 ADRs (0 PASS). Two sections: (A) Metadata Validation — every ADR is missing one or more of Date/Status/Authors (42 INFO + trailing WARNINGs). (B) Scope Conflicts — 399 WARNINGs generated by pairwise keyword overlap between ADRs that legitimately share a domain vocabulary (adapters, diff, http, etc.). (A) is a real schema gap fixable mechanically. (B) is mostly noise from the overlap heuristic, reducible by adding explicit cross-references in a small number of index ADRs rather than touching every pair.

steps.name: Backfill missing metadata headers on all ADRs
steps.description: For every ADR flagged in the Metadata Validation section, add the missing fields to the header: `- **Date**: <git-first-commit-date of file>`, `- **Status**: <current hex adr status>`, `- **Authors**: Gary Berger`. Source Date from `git log --diff-filter=A --format=%cs -- <file>` so the historical record stays accurate; default Status to the value returned by `hex adr list`. Do NOT overwrite any field that is already populated.
steps.done_condition: hex adr review shows 0 findings in the Metadata Validation section. `git diff docs/adrs/` only adds header fields — no body changes.

steps.name: Triage scope-conflict warnings into real vs heuristic
steps.description: Read every WARNING in the Scope Conflicts section and classify: (a) REAL — two ADRs actually make overlapping decisions that should reference each other (e.g. ADR-017 version-centric IA vs ADR-016 IA-and-states); (b) HEURISTIC — warnings fire only because both ADRs use generic vocabulary (diff, http, adapters) without actual decision overlap. Produce docs/workplans/adr-scope-conflict-triage-2026-04-21.md with one row per WARNING: classification + one-line justification.
steps.done_condition: Triage file exists with a verdict for every WARNING. Classification percentages recorded.

steps.name: Add Related-ADRs sections for REAL overlaps
steps.description: For every pair classified REAL in step-2, add a `## Related ADRs` block to each side with a one-line pointer to the other. Do not duplicate rationale — just cross-link. Target: reduce Scope Conflicts WARNINGs to zero for real overlaps.
steps.done_condition: All REAL-classified pairs have reciprocal `## Related ADRs` sections. hex adr review shows Scope Conflicts WARNINGs only for HEURISTIC pairs.

steps.name: Document heuristic false-positives or file a hex adr review tuning note
steps.description: If the remaining HEURISTIC warnings are still noisy, write a short ADR (or append to an existing meta ADR) acknowledging the keyword-overlap heuristic and listing the accepted-noise pairs. Alternative: file a hex issue suggesting the heuristic weight or stopword list be tightened. Do NOT suppress findings by editing ADR bodies to remove shared vocabulary.
steps.done_condition: Either (a) a meta ADR exists documenting accepted heuristic noise, or (b) an upstream hex issue/TODO is filed. No ADR content was altered purely to dodge the heuristic.

steps.name: Commit and verify
steps.description: Single commit: `chore(adr): reconcile hex adr review findings — backfill metadata + add Related-ADRs cross-references`. Re-run hex adr review and record before/after counts in the commit body. Run hex analyze . to confirm no architectural regressions.
steps.done_condition: Commit pushed. hex adr review Metadata Validation section = 0 findings. Scope Conflicts WARNING count reduced by >=50%. hex analyze clean.
